101: pub open spec fn size_of_bin(bin_idx: int) -> nat
102:     recommends valid_bin_idx(bin_idx)
103: {
104:     if 1 <= bin_idx <= 8 {
105:        (usize::BITS / 8) as nat * (bin_idx as nat)
106:     } else if bin_idx == BIN_HUGE {
107:         8 * (524288 + 1)
108:     } else {
109:         let group = (bin_idx - 9) / 4;
110:         let inner = (bin_idx - 9) % 4;
111:         ((usize::BITS / 8) * (inner + 5) * pow2((group + 1) as nat)) as nat
112:     }
113: }

115: pub open spec fn smallest_bin_fitting_size(size: int) -> int {
116:     let bytes_per_word = (usize::BITS / 8) as int;
117:     let wsize = (size + bytes_per_word - 1) / bytes_per_word;
118:     if wsize <= 1 { 1 }
119:     else if wsize <= 8 { wsize }
120:     else if wsize > 524288 { BIN_HUGE as int }
121:     else {
122:         let w = (wsize - 1) as u64;
123:         let lz = u64_leading_zeros(w);
124:         let b = (usize::BITS - 1 - lz) as u8;
125:         let shifted = (w >> (b - 2) as u64) as u8;
126:         ((b * 4) + (shifted & 0x03)) - 3
127:     }
128: }

372: pub open spec fn segment_u_max(s: Set<SegmentId>) -> int
373:     decreases s.len()
374: {
375:     if s.len() == 0 {
376:         0
377:     } else {
378:         let x = s.choose();
379:         vstd::math::max(segment_u_max(s.remove(x)), x.uniq)
380:     }
381: }

383: proof fn segment_u_max_not_in(s: Set<SegmentId>)
384:     ensures forall |id: SegmentId| s.contains(id) ==> id.uniq < segment_u_max(s) + 1,
385:     decreases s.len(),
386: {
387:     vstd::set_lib::lemma_set_empty_equivalency_len(s);
388:     if s.len() == 0 {
389:         assert(s === Set::empty());
390:     } else {
391:         let x = s.choose();
392:         let t = s.remove(x);
393:         segment_u_max_not_in(t);
394:     }

1136:     pub closed spec fn inv_delay_state_for_page(&self, page_id: PageId) -> bool {

1138:             DelayState::UseDelayedFree => {

1141:             DelayState::Freeing => {
